Write an e‐mail in French to the family and include the following details:  Give a brief description of the accommodation you require  Tell them some details about your area  Describe some activities that could interest tourists in Ireland  Say you will travel to France by boat and will bring a car  Say that your family likes cycling and ask if they have bicycles.
